scope: Bounded software verification of existing hardware preparation; no dashboard feature changes, real acquisition, deployment or work on the other six concepts.

arrival_package.difference_from_current_source: One additional 600-record regression test in tests/test_capture_summary.py; packaged tools, checklist and all other included sources match after CRLF normalization.

file_hygiene_review.limitations: Finite filename/header/marker review, not a comprehensive secret scan, malware analysis, full historical scan, source authentication or production certification. Findings would require interpretation; no secret values are exported.

first_physical_milestone.baseline: Reviewed 600-second stationary sensor-only capture; motor disconnected

remaining_dependencies: Complete receipt and identification of the original 30 selected products; owner reports partial receipt only.
Exact received-board pinouts, supply/shunt ratings, compatibility and ready bench reviewed by a qualified person.
Adequate existing reference capability and numerical targets agreed before collecting acceptance data.
Separate authorization for physical acquisition and the gated nonzero-current reference check.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures and finite software tests do not establish received-board compatibility, physical calibration, real fault prediction, industrial safety or complete production qualification. No hardware substitutions or new purchases are included.
